LESSON: FISHING IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: RESOURCES AND ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES IN EASTERN AFRICA
Topic 3.2: Fishing in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fishing in Eastern Africa, part of RESOURCES AND ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES IN EASTERN AFRICA in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is fishing important to us?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fishing in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Learners listen critically as they discuss, in groups challenges facing marine fishing in Eastern Africa.

• Learning to learn: Learners work collaboratively as they engage with a resource person to identify possible solutions to challenges

facing marine fishing in Eastern Africa.

Values:
● Unity: learners collaborate with others as they discuss, in groups, and write down possible solutions to challenges facing marine fishing in

Eastern Africa.

● Responsibility: learners proactively solve problems as they illustrate methods of marine fishing in Eastern Africa using appropriate media.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Self- awareness: learners discuss, in groups, and write down possible solutions to challenges facing marine fishing in Eastern Africa.

● Critical thinking: learners discuss, in groups, and write down possible solutions to challenges facing marine fishing in Eastern Africa.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Pre-technical studies: learners discuss the marine methods of fishing in Eastern Africa.

● Agriculture and nutrition: learners locate on a map the main fishing grounds in Eastern Africa.

Suggested Learning Resources

Local and extended environment, print and electronic maps, photographs, pictures, posters, internet sources, vetted digital resources,

adapted learners’ books and other printed resources ,
